powers.title: Assassin's Bane
powers.description: The ground blackens as coruscating energy swirls around you, hindering your foes' movements and revealing any hidden enemies.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone that lasts until the end of your next turn. Enemies within the zone cannot shift, teleport, or benefit from invisibility, concealment, or total concealment.
Sustain Minor: The zone persists.
powers.source: Published in Dark Sun Campaign Setting, page(s) 95.

powers.title: Beguiling Tongue
powers.description: You channel the grace and glibness of your fey patrons for a time. Your voice gains great power and eloquence.
rows: Effect: You gain a +5 power bonus to your next Bluff, Diplomacy, or Intimidate check during this encounter.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 133, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Caiphon's Leap
powers.description: You call upon Caiphon the Dream Whisperer, and with his aid, you move out of harm's way.
rows: Trigger: An enemy cursed by you hits you with a melee attack
Effect: You reduce the damage you take by your Charisma. You then teleport 2 squares.
powers.source: Published in Arcane Power, page(s) 75.

powers.title: Charm of Hearts
powers.description: Your enemies might not love you, but thanks to this charm crafted by the Prince of Hearts, they do not attack you when you give them the opportunity.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you do not provoke opportunity attacks and you gain a +2 power bonus to all defenses.
Sustain Minor: The effect persists.
powers.source: Published in Dragon Magazine 382, page(s) 60.

powers.title: Devil's Trade
powers.description: You call on infernal powers to trade a sliver of your soul for temporary relief.
rows: Effect: You gain vulnerable 5 to all damage until the end of your next turn, and you automatically succeed on one saving throw you make at the end of this turn.
powers.source: Published in Arcane Power, page(s) 75.

powers.title: Ethereal Stride
powers.description: You shift your body out of phase with the world for an instant, teleporting a short distance. When you reappear, you are still somewhat out of phase and difficult to harm or hinder for a short time.
rows: Effect: You can teleport 3 squares, and you gain a +2 power bonus to all defenses until the end of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 133, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Eyes of the Spider Queen
powers.description: A cluster of dull black eyes appears on your forehead, giving you enhanced sight in darkness and the power to see the unseen.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, you gain darkvision and can see invisible objects and creatures that are adjacent to you.
powers.source: Published in Arcane Power, page(s) 75.

powers.title: Fevered Certainty of Caiphon
powers.description: You send your thoughts to Caiphon, the Dream Whisperer, whose direction lies beyond the farthest void and is normally unknowable. Flush with the eldritch vision, a mad certainty floods your body and mind.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +5 power bonus to all skill checks, but you take a –2 penalty to your Will defense.
powers.source: Published in Dragon Magazine Annual, Dragon Magazine 366, page(s) 21.

powers.title: Fey Bargain
powers.description: You gain good luck now in exchange for bad luck later.
rows: Effect: You gain a +2 bonus to your next attack roll, but automatically fail your next saving throw before the end of the encounter.
powers.source: Published in Arcane Power, page(s) 75.

powers.title: Fiendish Resilience
powers.description: You call upon your patron entities to protect you with their fell power. Your flesh is infused with mystic strength, lessening the effect of enemy blows.
rows: Effect: You gain temporary hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 133, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Ruinous Phrase
powers.description: The words that leave your lips resonate within an object, causing it to shatter.
rows: Target: One unattended medium or smaller non-magical, inanimate object in the burst
Effect: If the target has hit points equal to 20 + your level or fewer, you destroy it. Otherwise, you deal it no damage and do not expend this power.
Infernal Pact: The target is destroyed if it has hit points equal to 25 + your level or fewer, instead of 20.
powers.source: Published in Dragon Magazine 382, page(s) 50.

powers.title: Shade Twin
powers.description: Darkness swirls around you. When it passes, you have taken on the guise of another creature.
rows: Target: One creature in the burst

Effect: You adopt the target's appearance until the end of your next turn. Creatures that observe you using this power are aware that you have done so. You gain a +5 power bonus to Bluff checks related to mimicking the target. Whenever you take damage while you have adopted the target's appearance, the target takes psychic damage equal to half the damage you take. Whenever the target takes damage from this effect, roll a d20. On a 10 or higher, the effect ends.
Sustain Minor: The effect persists until the end of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of Shadow, page(s) 67.

powers.title: Shadow Blend
powers.description: You draw forth shadow from the nearby darkness to conceal you from your foes.
rows: Trigger: You end your turn within 2 squares of a square of dim light or darkness.
Effect: You gain partial concealment until the start of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of Shadow, page(s) 90.

powers.title: Shadow Veil
powers.description: You garb yourself in a pall of murky darkness. While it lasts you are difficult to see or hear.
rows: Effect: You gain a +5 power bonus to Stealth checks until the end of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 133, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Spectral Fade
powers.description: You become misty and transparent, fading from your enemies' view for a moment.
rows: Effect: You become invisible until the end of your turn.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 209, Heroes of Shadow, page(s) 67.

powers.title: Spider Scuttle
powers.description: Shadowy spider legs sprout from your body, allowing you to scuttle across the ground and easily scale a nearby surface.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a climb speed equal to your speed, and you can move at that speed when you crawl.
powers.source: Published in Forgotten Realms Player's Guide, page(s) 36, Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 209.

powers.title: Stony Roots
powers.description: You draw elemental earth through your body to ensure that nothing can dislodge you from your position.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, you can ignore forced movement, and you can make a saving throw when an attack would knock you prone. On a save, you don't fall prone.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Elemental Chaos, page(s) 102.

powers.title: Wrathful Aspect
powers.description: Your eyes glow with power, and a cloak of red fire swirls around you as you channel the wrath and fury of your pact.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +5 power bonus to Intimidate checks, and any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 5 fire damage.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 209.

powers.title: Astral Eyes
powers.description: Your eyes exude the light that bathes the Astral Sea, sharpening your sight and allowing you to perceive subtle details with ease.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain darkvision and a +2 power bonus to Insight checks and Perception checks.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 212.

powers.title: Chaos Armor
powers.description: Power flows around you, girding you against the elements and lashing your enemies.
rows: Effect: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Until the end of the encounter, you gain resist 10 to the chosen damage type. In addition, whenever an enemy hits you with an attack during your turn, one enemy within 5 squares of you takes damage of the chosen type equal to your Constitution.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Elemental Chaos, page(s) 103.

powers.title: Dark One's Own Luck
powers.description: Refusing the result that fate has decreed for you, you invoke stars of chaos and uncertainty and try to rewrite what has been written.
rows: Trigger: You make a roll you dislike
Effect: Reroll the attack roll, skill check, ability check, or saving throw, using the higher of the two results.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 134, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Fate's Frayed Thread
powers.description: With one miss, the fates collude against your enemy, heralding its ultimate doom.
rows: Trigger: An enemy misses you with an attack
Target: The triggering enemy
Effect: You place your Warlock's Curse on the target. Also, until the end of your next turn, the target takes a –2 penalty to attack rolls against you and grants combat advantage to you.
powers.source: Published in Dragon Magazine 382, page(s) 60.

powers.title: Fey Switch
powers.description: You step through the veils of the Feywild to the place where an ally stands and return to the world in that spot. Your ally is instantly whisked back to the place you started from.
rows: Target: You and one willing ally
Effect: You and your ally trade spaces.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 134, Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 212, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Iron Aspect of Dispater
powers.description: Your skin becomes as hard as iron, making you immovable against your foes' attacks.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain resist 5 to all damage and can ignore forced movement.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 212.

powers.title: Life Siphon
powers.description: It's not pretty, it's not kind, but sometimes you need to draw power from an ally's pain.
rows: Trigger: An ally within 10 squares of you takes damage
Effect: You gain a +2 power bonus to one attack roll before the end of your next turn.
Dark Pact: You regain hit points equal to your Charisma.
Infernal Pact: You gain temporary hit points equal to twice your Constitution.
powers.source: Published in Arcane Power, page(s) 77.

powers.title: Mercurial Form
powers.description: Your form flows and shimmers, allowing you to slip through cracks, escape an enemy's claws, and evade even the most persistent hunter.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, you cannot be marked, you are considered Tiny for the purpose of squeezing, and you can automatically succeed at escaping from a grab as a free action.
powers.source: Published in Arcane Power, page(s) 77.

powers.title: Mirror Darkly
powers.description: Your shadowy double appears at a distance, letting you split your essence between two points on the battlefield.
rows: Effect: You conjure a shade in an unoccupied square within range. The shade occupies its square and lasts until the end of your next turn. The shade can be attacked. It uses your defenses, and it is destroyed if it takes any damage. While the shade persists, you are insubstantial and you can use your space or the shade's space as the origin of your attacks.
Aftereffect: You can teleport to a square formerly occupied by the shade.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of Shadow, page(s) 91.

powers.title: Racing Fire of Ulban
powers.description: You move with the swiftness of Ulban, whose burning glory sometimes flashes across the sky in a fiery streak of blue and white.
rows: Effect: You move twice your speed.
powers.source: Published in Arcane Power, page(s) 77.

powers.title: Red Leeches of Nihal
powers.description: Wriggling scarlet worms writhe suddenly across your foe's body before dissolving just as quickly into odious vapor. When their rank odor stings your nostrils, stolen energy shudders through you.
rows: Trigger: One target in range spends an action point or a healing surge.
Effect: You gain a number of temporary hit points equal to your second wind value.
powers.source: Published in Dragon Magazine Annual, Dragon Magazine 366, page(s) 21.

powers.title: Rending Fear of Khirad
powers.description: A pale blue flame springs up from your brow as you incant the apocalypses over which Khirad has burned, thus hoping to frighten your foe into an admission.
rows: Target: One helpless intelligent enemy

Effect: You demand that the target answer one question. If you share a language, your helpless target provides the answer to the best of its knowledge, without distortion. Each round, ask a new question if your target remains helpless, up to a number of questions equal to 1 + your Charisma.
powers.source: Published in Dragon Magazine Annual, Dragon Magazine 366, page(s) 22.

powers.title: Sand Shape
powers.description: You transform your body into sand, allowing you to resist attacks and pass through solid barriers.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you are insubstantial and can pass through any opening large enough to accommodate a single grain of sand. You cannot attack, pick up anything, or manipulate objects.
Sustain Minor: The effect persists.
powers.source: Published in Dark Sun Campaign Setting, page(s) 95.

powers.title: Shadow Ride
powers.description: Your body flows as liquid darkness, pooling around another creature like a second shadow.
rows: Effect: You shift up to 2 squares and can enter any enemy's space during this movement. You can end this movement in an enemy's space. If you do so, whenever the enemy moves before the start of your next turn, you move with it, remaining in its space. You do not provoke opportunity attacks for this movement. At the start of your next turn, you appear in the nearest unoccupied square.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of Shadow, page(s) 69.

powers.title: Shadowslip
powers.description: They wanted blood. You give them shadow.
rows: Trigger: An enemy misses you with a melee or a ranged attack
Effect: Teleport a number of squares equal to your Charisma.
powers.source: Published in Forgotten Realms Player's Guide, page(s) 37.

powers.title: Shroud of Black Steel
powers.description: Invoking the power of your dark patrons, you transform your skin into living steel, blackened and hard yet still supple enough to move. Your quickness suffers a bit, but you are much tougher and more resilient.
rows: Effect: You change your skin into living steel. You gain a +2 power bonus to AC and Fortitude defense but take a -2 penalty to speed until the end of the encounter. You can end this effect as a minor action.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 134, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Spider Climb
powers.description: You bestow on yourself the ability to cling to almost any surface and climb as easily as an insect.
rows: Effect: On this move action, you move with a climb speed equal to your speed.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 134, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Spider Queen's Caress
powers.description: You whisper to those who dwell in the darkness of your undying love and loyalty, and in return you gain the gift of stealth.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, you gain a +2 power bonus to saving throws and Stealth checks.
Dark Pact: Your Shadow Walk grants concealment to you after you move 2 squares instead of 3.
powers.source: Published in Arcane Power, page(s) 78.

powers.title: Unspeakable Bond
powers.description: The injury you sustain vanishes and reappears on a nearby ally, and with it comes a cold anger that makes your ally a more dangerous combatant.
rows: Trigger: You are damaged by an attack
Target: One willing ally

Effect: The target takes the damage from the triggering attack instead of you. You still take any other effects from the attack. The target gains a +2 power bonus to attack rolls and a +5 power bonus to damage rolls until the end of your next turn.
Infernal Pact: The target also gains a +2 power bonus to all defenses until the end of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Dragon Magazine 382, page(s) 50.

powers.title: Walk Through Darkness
powers.description: As you move, your body becomes shadow, slipping through foes and barriers with equal ease.
rows: Effect: You shift up to 10 squares. You are phasing and insubstantial during this shift.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of Shadow, page(s) 69.

powers.title: Accursed Souls
powers.description: The souls of those who fall while bearing your curse explode from their bodies to slay more of your foes.
rows: Trigger: An enemy you have cursed is reduced to 0 hit points or fewer.
Effect: Until the end of the encounter, whenever an enemy you have cursed is reduced to 0 hit points or fewer, enemies adjacent to that target take 10 necrotic damage.
powers.source: Published in Dragon Magazine 372, page(s) 23.

powers.title: Ambassador Imp
powers.description: You conjure forth an implike presence from the netherworld and give it a message to deliver to a far-off creature.
rows: Effect: You whisper a message into the air, and an implike presence appears next to the creature you wish to speak to and delivers your message. If the creature has a reply, the imp appears adjacent to you at the end of your next turn to utter it. If the creature has no reply or is not within range, the imp appears adjacent to you at the end of your next turn to tell you so. The imp then disappears.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 136, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Bond of Brotherhood
powers.description: An ancient enclave of eladrin shared in each other's triumphs and pain; you borrow their magic to benefit from your ally's healing.
rows: Trigger: An ally within 10 squares of you spends a healing surge
Effect: You regain hit points equal to the amount the triggering ally regains.
powers.source: Published in Arcane Power, page(s) 80.

powers.title: Bridge of Shades
powers.description: Twin pools of darkness shimmer to life at your command, creating a shadowy bridge between them.
rows: Effect: Choose two squares in range. Until the end of your next turn, the two squares are considered to be adjacent to each other for the purpose of movement or making melee attacks. Moving from one square to the other is teleportation, although a creature doesn't need to be able to see the destination square.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of Shadow, page(s) 70.

powers.title: Brimstone Caress
powers.description: With a single swift word, you cause an ally to erupt in hellish flames and reappear.
rows: Target: One ally
Effect: The target takes fire damage equal to half your level and teleports 5 squares.
Infernal Pact: The target gains concealment until the start of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Dragon Magazine 382, page(s) 50.

powers.title: Curse of Nessus
powers.description: You transform your bad luck into your enemy's misfortune.
rows: Trigger: You miss an enemy with an attack
Target: The enemy you missed
Effect: The target takes a -5 penalty to saving throws until the end of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Arcane Power, page(s) 80.

powers.title: Darkest Mirror
powers.description: A dark membrane snaps shut over your eyes. They reflect another world now, filled with shadows and spectral foes.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, you can see invisible creatures as if they were not invisible. All other creatures, including your allies, are invisible to you. You can end this effect as a minor action.
powers.source: Published in Forgotten Realms Player's Guide, page(s) 38.

powers.title: Destiny Inversion
powers.description: You untangle the threads of fate, rearranging them to suit your whims.
rows: Trigger: An attack hits you

Effect: You take no damage from the triggering attack. Instead, you take ongoing damage equal to half the triggering attack's damage (save ends). The ongoing damage has the same damage type as the triggering attack.
powers.source: Published in Arcane Power, page(s) 80.

powers.title: Duelist's Dance
powers.description: You slip through the planar firmament with ease, dancing away from your enemies' attacks in much the same manner as the rakes and bravos that inhabit the Feywild's strange cities.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, you can use the secondary power at will.
Duelist's Dance Secondary Power
At-Will ✦     Arcane, Teleportation
Immediate Reaction      Personal
Requirement: The power Duelist's Dance must be active in order to use this power.
Trigger: An enemy attacks you.
Effect: You teleport up to 3 squares.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 214.

powers.title: Ethereal Sidestep
powers.description: You slip through a rift in reality and appear a few feet away.
rows: Effect: You teleport 1 square.
powers.source: Published in PH Heroes: Series 1.

powers.title: King's Step
powers.description: After an enemy misses you with an attack, you take a form of sand and ash. You then zip across the battlefield and lay your curse upon the offending creature.
rows: Trigger: An enemy misses you with an attack.
Effect: You fly your speed and are insubstantial during the move. After the move, you place your Warlock's Curse on the triggering enemy.
powers.source: Published in Dark Sun Campaign Setting, page(s) 96.

powers.title: Murky Deep
powers.description: A bead of moisture appears above your head and expands into great shimmering strands of befouled water.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone of lightly obscured squares that lasts until the end of your next turn. When you shift without leaving the zone, you can shift up to 2 additional squares in the zone. Any enemy that enters the zone or starts its turn there is slowed until the start of its next turn. A creature that has a swim speed ignores this effect.
Sustain Minor: The zone persists until the end of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Elemental Chaos, page(s) 103.

powers.title: Shade Dance
powers.description: As you maneuver across the battlefield, you take on the form of living shadow to frustrate your foes' attacks.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, whenever you complete a move of at least 3 squares on your turn, you can become insubstantial until the start of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of Shadow, page(s) 91.

powers.title: Shadow Armor
powers.description: Shadow coalesces around you to take the form of a macabre suit of plate armor.
rows: Effect: You gain a +2 power bonus to Stealth checks and a +2 power bonus to all defenses until the end of the encounter. As a minor action, you can end this effect and then teleport up to 5 squares. You then become invisible until the end of your next turn, or until you hit or miss with an attack roll.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of Shadow, page(s) 70.

powers.title: Shadow Form
powers.description: You fly apart into a swarm of batlike shadows.
rows: Effect: You assume a shadowy form until the end of the encounter or for 5 minutes. In this form you are insubstantial, gain fly 6, and can't take standard actions. Reverting to your normal form is a minor action.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 136, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Shielding Shades
powers.description: You call up a swirling shield of darkness from some far domain, interposing it between yourself and dire peril.
rows: Trigger: You are hit and damaged by an attack
Effect: The damage against you drops to 0.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 136, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Smothering Darkness
powers.description: You reach into the Shadowfell and pull dark shadows around yourself. At the same time, that plane's dark energy infuses your eyes, allowing you to see easily in the darkest night.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone that lasts until the end of your next turn. The zone blocks line of sight for all creatures except you. You also gain darkvision while the zone persists.
Sustain Minor: The zone persists until the end of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 214.

powers.title: Spined Devil's Boon
powers.description: You steal the essence of a spined devil, gaining wings and a protective layer of barbed quills.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, you gain a fly speed of 6, and any enemy that hits you with a melee attack takes 5 damage.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 214.

powers.title: Transcendent Dance
powers.description: For a moment, your mind and body are in harmony, and you achieve the pinnacle of grace and speed.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, you gain a bonus to speed and saving throws equal to your Intelligence (minimum 1).
powers.source: Published in Arcane Power, page(s) 80.

powers.title: Troublesome Aid of Caiphon
powers.description: When an ally grants you the grace of renewed health, you leverage your knowledge of Caiphon's healing lore to gain even greater advantage than was offered—but at what price?
rows: Trigger: One ally in range grants you the use of a healing surge.

Effect: In addition to the normal number of hit points you regain, you regain a number of hit points equal to your healing surge value. However, until the end of the encounter, you die after failing your second, rather than third, death saving throw.
powers.source: Published in Dragon Magazine Annual, Dragon Magazine 366, page(s) 22.

powers.title: Warlock's Leap
powers.description: You leap through the mystic veil into the Feywild. An instant later, you return a short distance away and alight without traveling through the intervening air.
rows: Effect: You teleport 6 squares. You do not need line of sight to the destination, but if you attempt to teleport to a space you can't occupy, you don't move.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 136, Class Compendium.
